messages:
Priya Nair: Heads-up: Sparrow Health sent an RFI this morning attached to the email. They want (A) a filled capability matrix, (B) short answers to their security questionnaire, (C) POC scope + timeline (2-week eval + integration week preferred), and (D) a pricing comparison for Dedicated vs Hosted. Can owners drop micro-answers here so I can assemble a single ZIP by EOD tomorrow?

Tom Rivera: On it. I'll draft the capability matrix entries and a one-paragraph ops summary. Quick Q: do we propose a warm-standby Hosted fallback or cold fallback? Warm affects baseline cost. :thinking_face:

Mei Wong: Recommend warm-standby for latency-sensitive endpoints — tradeoff is small extra baseline for much lower tail latency. I'll add a note about model pinning and rollout safety.

Priya Nair: Good. Tom, can you also include a bloated-compat line for their on-prem model export ask?

Tom Rivera: Yep. Minimal CSV snippet below to paste into their matrix: ```
feature,offering,notes
Model hosting,Dedicated (customer VPC),pin model version,hardware isolation
Burst handling,Hosted fallback,warm standby + auto-failover
Quantization,Supported,FP16/INT8 recommended for cost
SLOs,p95 <150ms (dedicated),p95 ~300ms (hosted fallback)
```

Ben (Finance): Pricing preview (needs sign-off):
- Dedicated reserved (3x A100 equiv): $48,000/mo commit
- Hosted fallback (per-token burst): $0.0011/token
- POC credit: 75% credits for first 10 days
- Integration services (KMS + onboarding): $9,500 one-time
(Will formalize in sheet)

Priya Nair: Excellent. Sparrow asked specifically about HSM and data residency (EU). Mei, can you confirm HSM/BYOK flow + Eu region availability?

Mei Wong: Confirmed: EU regions available (eu-west-1 and eu-central-1), support for customer-managed KMS + BYOK with HSM-backed keys. Uploading a diagram and an excerpted KMS integration note.

Mei Wong: Uploads: sparrow_kms_flow.png, kms_integration_note.txt

Tom Rivera: Security questionnaire status: answered most items, left two items on FedRAMP equivalence and 3rd-party attestation for HSM. Proposed mitigation: offer an attestation window + external auditor summary; flag timeline (2-3 weeks).

Priya Nair: LegalBot, do we have a POC addendum template for healthcare customers (DPA + HIPAA considerations)?

LegalBot: Uploaded template: POC_Addendum_HIPAA_template_v3.docx. Note: Data processing addendum needs signed BA for PHI; we can do a limited POC BA if customer signs BA with scoping for sample PHI redaction.

Ben (Finance): I'll create the pricing_sheet_Sparrow_1805550000.xlsx and capability_matrix_Sparrow_1805550000.csv and drop links here when ready.

Priya Nair: Sparrow is hoping to start POC on April 6th if we can provide creds + onboarding runbook by April 2nd. Who owns sandbox provisioning and test dataset ingest?

Tom Rivera: I can provision the sandbox and put the CLI snippet in the runbook. Need Sparrow engineer email and S3 bucket details. CLI snippet: ```
redwoodctl provision --org sparrow-health --env sparrow-poc --model redwood-llm-opt --commit 3
redwoodctl roles grant --env sparrow-poc --user user@sparrow.com --role engineer
redwoodctl upload --env sparrow-poc --source s3://sparrow-poc/testdata --preserve-ids
```

Mei Wong: Also add a short note about data retention for POC: "Inputs are processed transiently; by default we do not persist request payloads beyond cache TTL. Any logging or telemetry retention is opt-in and encrypted at rest with KMS."

Priya Nair: Perfect. Tom/Mei please paste your one-liners here and I'll assemble.

Tom Rivera: One-liner ops blurb: "We provide dedicated sandbox clusters with model pinning and warm-hosted fallback. Onboarding includes CLI provisioning and S3 dataset sync; expected setup time 1-2 business days."

Mei Wong: One-liner security blurb: "Supports customer-managed KMS (BYOK) with HSM-backed keys, EU region deployments, role-restricted audited access, and optional attestation via third-party auditor."

Priya Nair: RFP Bot: Reminder to attach capability CSV + single PDF answers bundle in the RFP response zip. Naming convention: Sparrow_RFI_Response_1805550000.zip

RFP Bot: Also flag: include SOC2 redacted excerpt and KMS diagram.

Ben (Finance): Uploaded pricing_sheet_Sparrow_1805550000.xlsx and capability_matrix_Sparrow_1805550000.csv

Priya Nair: Legal confirmed BA requirement. LegalBot will send a scoped BA for POC; we can propose redaction of PHI or synthetic dataset if BA signing will delay start.

Tom Rivera: No infra blockers. Will provision sandbox once Sparrow approves BA path and provides engineer contact.

Priya Nair: Thanks team. I'll stitch the CSV, security Q&A, pricing sheet, and legal addendum into Sparrow_RFI_Response_1805550000.zip and share the sent copy here when done. :thumbsup:
